name: code-to-mindmap
title: 代码到思维导图
description: Use when (1) user pastes source code and wants to visualize it as a mind map, node graph, or tree diagram.  (2) user says "show this as a mindmap", "draw the architecture", "make a flowchart of this code", or  "visualize the structure". (3) user wants to understand an unfamiliar codebase by seeing its structure visually.
